cohort: 87,461 live births at a tertiary maternity hospital in the United Kingdom between 2000 and 2016.
finding: The obstetric neonatal nerve injury rate was low (0.085%), with brachial plexus injury rate (0.051%) being about one third of historical rates.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery, ventouse delivery, and emergency cesarean section were significantly associated with facial nerve injury, while forceps delivery, ventouse delivery, and birthweight were significantly associated with brachial plexus injury.
